theorem bbolt.metaR.congr_simp [hos : HasExt osFsExt] (B B✝ : bbolt.BNs) (e_B : B = B✝) (db db✝ :
    Loc) (e_db : db = db✝) (p p✝ : GoString) (e_p : p = p✝) : bbolt.metaR B db p = bbolt.metaR B✝
    db✝ p✝

theorem bbolt.mapFields_combine [hos : HasExt osFsExt] (db : Loc) (a b : Qp) (ms1 ms2 : bbolt.MapSt)
    : bbolt.mapFields db (DFrac.own a) ms1 ∗ bbolt.mapFields db (DFrac.own b) ms2 ⊢ ⌜ms1 = ms2⌝ ∗
    bbolt.mapFields db (DFrac.own (a + b)) ms1

def bbolt.closeStats (st : go_etcd_io.bbolt.Stats) (ts : go_etcd_io.bbolt.TxStats) (fl : bbolt.FLPg)
    : go_etcd_io.bbolt.Stats :=
  { TxStats' := ts, FreePageN' := W64 ↑fl.free.length, PendingPageN' := W64 ↑fl.pendingIds.length,
    FreeAlloc' := (W64 ↑fl.free.length + W64 ↑fl.pendingIds.length) * W64 4096,
    FreelistInuse' := W64 ↑(16 + 8 * (fl.allIds.length + if 65535 ≤ fl.allIds.length then 1 else 0)), TxN' := st.TxN',
    OpenTxN' := st.OpenTxN' }

theorem bbolt.wtxHeap_root_out [hos : HasExt osFsExt] (tx : Loc) (X : bbolt.WX) (B : bbolt.BRec) (hb
    : X.t.bs !! X.rl = some B) : bbolt.wtxHeap tx (DFrac.own 1) X ⊢ bbolt.txFields tx (DFrac.own 1)
    X ∗ bbolt.rootFill tx (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ⌜X.rl = bbolt.txRoot tx ∧ B.bv.tx' = tx⌝ ∗ typedPointsto
    (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.bbolt.Bucket go!"InBucket" X.rl) B.bv.InBucket' (DFrac.own 1) ∗
    typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.bbolt.Bucket go!"tx" X.rl) B.bv.tx' (DFrac.own 1) ∗
    typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.bbolt.Bucket go!"buckets" X.rl) B.bv.buckets'
    (DFrac.own 1) ∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.bbolt.Bucket go!"page" X.rl) B.bv.page'
    (DFrac.own 1) ∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.bbolt.Bucket go!"rootNode" X.rl)
    B.bv.rootNode' (DFrac.own 1) ∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.bbolt.Bucket go!"nodes"
    X.rl) B.bv.nodes' (DFrac.own 1)
